text_block_list.text:
At the end of their serious bout, Meisho
Doto
loses to Т.М. Опера О. However,
the two
establish a rivalry at last.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О presses Мэйсё Дото,
wondering
why she's never shown this
level of effort before.
The two laugh
together and promise to no longer
hold
back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This new step in their relationship also
manifests
in better lap times, convincing
Air Shakur the two
have broken past
their previous stat ceiling.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's no longer certain who will emerge
victorious in
the race against the
previous generation. The two
head for
the Arima Kinen as true competitors.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
